plan.treatment: Only the ordering weights change against each frozen learned-expanded pair; same complete inventory, model, feature units, seed, budgets, proposal generation and complete fallback.
plan.reuse: Only byte-identical whole requests from the fully independently replayed prior native ledger or an earlier independently audited new acceptance may be reused. Prior preparation and replay costs remain disclosed as historical shared dependencies; incremental setup, hash checking, model construction, search, serialization, lookup and fresh computation/replay are separately charged.
plan.measurement: All 16 added trials, paired attempt and graph/proposal counters, status and whole native outcome; preparation/search/native/audit costs and process peak RSS. Two repetitions use the same deterministic seed, not independent statistical samples. No new RL training or significance claim.
plan.scope: Guarded symbolic Hilbert incidence fragment, unchanged 28 or 76 high-level point interfaces; no literal primitive-square equivalence, full Euclidean geometry, or quantified closure claim.

promoted.scope: Complete predeclared level-one interfaces plus all exact discovered-family matches.

feature_cost_accounting.scope: Expanded-word feature work is included in search and proposal elapsed times. The unchanged engine has one inclusive proposal timer covering generation, validation, feature construction and scoring; no separate feature-only time is inferred. Position and vector counts cover every scored proposal, including repeated work at different search states.

summary.assessment: This isolates fixed versus frozen learned ordering weights on exactly equal word-expanded point models. The four recipients are two hypothesis configurations at two finite boundary lengths, not four independent mathematical theorems. Any observed attempt difference is specific to these deterministic recipients; two same-seed timing repetitions are not independent samples. No new RL training, universal superiority, or total-cost speed claim. Prior cold preparation and full replay costs remain visible; new certificate verification costs and overlapping audit wait are charged separately.
